notes.title: Patch v1.6
notes.content:
Patch v1.6 contains more optimizations.

- Flash Jumps cannot be clicked multiple times in fast succession anymore
- Fixed a problem where the landlord collected the double rent amount (so greedy!)
- Fullscreen settings fix
- Post process volume fix
- Textures optimization
- Fixed text fields
- Point counters update
- Control table design with centered screws

Happy summer clicking everyone.

notes.title: Patch v1.5
notes.content: - added Crew Time update

notes.title: Big Fat Update
notes.content:
ːsteamthisː It's now harder to get upgrades BUT you now get more perks from them!

This is what we added:

Crew energy multiplier

Vinyl energy multiplier

Song energy multiplier

Follower energy multiplier

Home energy multiplier

Getting new Crew Members now costs energy but grants more XP and energy

Buying Homes grants you rising amounts of XP and energy

Minor bugfixes



Have fun and Happy Clicking! ː8bitheartː

notes.title: Patch 1.0.6
notes.content:
Update Notes for patch 1.0.6

Added a new Loop Speed knob slider. This knob let's you control the loop speed freely, as sometimes it's nicer to not have the lights go wild constantly. The knob unlocks after buying all the Loop Speed upgrades (100 max).

Also some minor changes and bugfixes, for example some of the residence preview images on the map not being the correct ones.

Happy Halloween and Happy Clicking.

notes.title: Patch v1.0.4
notes.content:
A patch a day keeps the doctor away.


 Changed the system of how energy is calculated to hopefully fix a bug that caused players to get very high negative numbers showing up
 Added functionality to the Shop to allow multiple XP gains when multiple residences are bought
 Adjusted the feel of the buy buttons for Lights, Auto Loop and Loop Speed, as well as for the Switch track button

If you encounter any more bugs, please come over to or Discord and let us know.
Happy clicking. <3

notes.title: Another day, another patch
notes.content:
Today's patch includes:


 Added a Leaderboard Button to Live intro screens
 Ray Tracing optimization for some effects


Happy clicking.

notes.title: Patch v1.0.3
notes.content:
Bugfixes for v1.0.3


 Fixed a problem with the track buy button. It should now behave correctly
 Fixed a bug that allowed players to get unlimited XP when leaving the shop multiple times
 Hopefully fixed a bug that caused the energy level to go into negative numbers. Player CAZ set the world's lowest energy score with "-859,490,423"
 Some text corrections


Happy clicking! ːsteammockingː

notes.title: Quality of Life Updates
notes.content:
Some Updates that should make life better:


 Focus on the main button when chaning tracks
 Text corrections
 Set the ending to appear only after completing all 3 challenges on last location
 Housecat appearing less frequently now
 Aria character changes (no more "Pennywise face")
 Deactivated more unused engine plugins


Please let me know if you find any other bugs. 
Happy clicking!
